00046 template <>
00047 void    FFTRealPassDirect <1>::process (long len, DataType dest_ptr [], DataType src_ptr [], const DataType x_ptr [], const DataType cos_ptr [], long cos_len, const long br_ptr [], OscType osc_list [])
00048 {
00049     // First and second pass at once
00050     const long      qlen = len >> 2;
00051 
00052     long                coef_index = 0;
00053     do
00054     {
00055         // To do: unroll the loop (2x).
00056         const long      ri_0 = br_ptr [coef_index >> 2];
00057         const long      ri_1 = ri_0 + 2 * qlen; // bit_rev_lut_ptr [coef_index + 1];
00058         const long      ri_2 = ri_0 + 1 * qlen; // bit_rev_lut_ptr [coef_index + 2];
00059         const long      ri_3 = ri_0 + 3 * qlen; // bit_rev_lut_ptr [coef_index + 3];
00060 
00061         DataType    * const df2 = dest_ptr + coef_index;
00062         df2 [1] = x_ptr [ri_0] - x_ptr [ri_1];
00063         df2 [3] = x_ptr [ri_2] - x_ptr [ri_3];
00064 
00065         const DataType  sf_0 = x_ptr [ri_0] + x_ptr [ri_1];
00066         const DataType  sf_2 = x_ptr [ri_2] + x_ptr [ri_3];
00067 
00068         df2 [0] = sf_0 + sf_2;
00069         df2 [2] = sf_0 - sf_2;
00070 
00071         coef_index += 4;
00072     }
00073     while (coef_index < len);
00074 }

00076 template <>
00077 void    FFTRealPassDirect <2>::process (long len, DataType dest_ptr [], DataType src_ptr [], const DataType x_ptr [], const DataType cos_ptr [], long cos_len, const long br_ptr [], OscType osc_list [])
00078 {
00079     // Executes "previous" passes first. Inverts source and destination buffers
00080     FFTRealPassDirect <1>::process (
00081         len,
00082         src_ptr,
00083         dest_ptr,
00084         x_ptr,
00085         cos_ptr,
00086         cos_len,
00087         br_ptr,
00088         osc_list
00089     );
00090 
00091     // Third pass
00092     const DataType  sqrt2_2 = DataType (SQRT2 * 0.5);
00093 
00094     long                coef_index = 0;
00095     do
00096     {
00097         dest_ptr [coef_index    ] = src_ptr [coef_index] + src_ptr [coef_index + 4];
00098         dest_ptr [coef_index + 4] = src_ptr [coef_index] - src_ptr [coef_index + 4];
00099         dest_ptr [coef_index + 2] = src_ptr [coef_index + 2];
00100         dest_ptr [coef_index + 6] = src_ptr [coef_index + 6];
00101 
00102         DataType            v;
00103 
00104         v = (src_ptr [coef_index + 5] - src_ptr [coef_index + 7]) * sqrt2_2;
00105         dest_ptr [coef_index + 1] = src_ptr [coef_index + 1] + v;
00106         dest_ptr [coef_index + 3] = src_ptr [coef_index + 1] - v;
00107 
00108         v = (src_ptr [coef_index + 5] + src_ptr [coef_index + 7]) * sqrt2_2;
00109         dest_ptr [coef_index + 5] = v + src_ptr [coef_index + 3];
00110         dest_ptr [coef_index + 7] = v - src_ptr [coef_index + 3];
00111 
00112         coef_index += 8;
00113     }
00114     while (coef_index < len);
00115 }

00117 template <int PASS>
00118 void    FFTRealPassDirect <PASS>::process (long len, DataType dest_ptr [], DataType src_ptr [], const DataType x_ptr [], const DataType cos_ptr [], long cos_len, const long br_ptr [], OscType osc_list [])
00119 {
00120     // Executes "previous" passes first. Inverts source and destination buffers
00121     FFTRealPassDirect <PASS - 1>::process (
00122         len,
00123         src_ptr,
00124         dest_ptr,
00125         x_ptr,
00126         cos_ptr,
00127         cos_len,
00128         br_ptr,
00129         osc_list
00130     );
00131 
00132     const long      dist = 1L << (PASS - 1);
00133     const long      c1_r = 0;
00134     const long      c1_i = dist;
00135     const long      c2_r = dist * 2;
00136     const long      c2_i = dist * 3;
00137     const long      cend = dist * 4;
00138     const long      table_step = cos_len >> (PASS - 1);
00139 
00140    enum {   TRIGO_OSC       = PASS - FFTRealFixLenParam::TRIGO_BD_LIMIT };
00141     enum {  TRIGO_DIRECT    = (TRIGO_OSC >= 0) ? 1 : 0  };
00142 
00143     long                coef_index = 0;
00144     do
00145     {
00146         const DataType  * const sf = src_ptr + coef_index;
00147         DataType            * const df = dest_ptr + coef_index;
00148 
00149         // Extreme coefficients are always real
00150         df [c1_r] = sf [c1_r] + sf [c2_r];
00151         df [c2_r] = sf [c1_r] - sf [c2_r];
00152         df [c1_i] = sf [c1_i];
00153         df [c2_i] = sf [c2_i];
00154 
00155         FFTRealUseTrigo <TRIGO_DIRECT>::prepare (osc_list [TRIGO_OSC]);
00156 
00157         // Others are conjugate complex numbers
00158         for (long i = 1; i < dist; ++ i)
00159         {
00160             DataType            c;
00161             DataType            s;
00162             FFTRealUseTrigo <TRIGO_DIRECT>::iterate (
00163                 osc_list [TRIGO_OSC],
00164                 c,
00165                 s,
00166                 cos_ptr,
00167                 i * table_step,
00168                 (dist - i) * table_step
00169             );
00170 
00171             const DataType  sf_r_i = sf [c1_r + i];
00172             const DataType  sf_i_i = sf [c1_i + i];
00173 
00174             const DataType  v1 = sf [c2_r + i] * c - sf [c2_i + i] * s;
00175             df [c1_r + i] = sf_r_i + v1;
00176             df [c2_r - i] = sf_r_i - v1;
00177 
00178             const DataType  v2 = sf [c2_r + i] * s + sf [c2_i + i] * c;
00179             df [c2_r + i] = v2 + sf_i_i;
00180             df [cend - i] = v2 - sf_i_i;
00181         }
00182 
00183         coef_index += cend;
00184     }
00185     while (coef_index < len);
00186 }
